metadata.description: Kitsu: verified coding tasks and a Git check-evidence gate, plus role coordination that you can turn off.

plugins.name: kitsu
plugins.description: Open, verify and commit a coding task with one command, with evidence bound to the exact Git tree. The Git gate adds a safeguard for commits and pushes backed by recorded checks.

plugins.name: kitsu-team
plugins.description: Experimental: run a coding task through a developer agent, your approved checks and a reviewer agent that Kitsu coordinates in code. On request: seven specialist roles coordinated in the chat, OpenSpec records, role settings and supervised runs. Installed with Kitsu unless you turn it off. Needs the kitsu plugin.
